_comment: Model-decides tier procedure library (research design doc: .scratch/research/model-decides-tier-design.md, board Lane MEASURE CLAUDE.md Task 2). CONTENT-IDENTICAL COPY of fixtures/micro/procedures.json's `procedures` array - the design's own point (§2) is that no new procedure cards need authoring for wave 1, the existing four stale/fresh pairs already cover it. Kept as a separate file (not a shared path) so this tier's tasks.json can live outside the micro pack's mandated 8-12 scenario count without touching fixtures/micro/** at all. A drift tripwire test (tests/test_model_decides.py) asserts the `procedures` array here stays byte-identical to the micro copy; if one changes, the other should too or the test explains why not.
